args.body:
Dear Priya,

Thank you for bringing this urgent login loop issue to our attention. I understand this is blocking your users, and we're taking this very seriously.

I've noted your complaint and connected it to our existing support ticket T-ext-E_CH_2_004, which has been marked as high priority. Our team is currently investigating this login loop issue.

Could you please provide any additional details about:
1. When this issue started occurring?
2. Which specific users or user groups are affected?
3. Any error messages or specific behavior you're seeing in the login loop?
4. Steps you've already tried to resolve it?

This information will help us expedite the resolution. We'll provide updates on ticket T-ext-E_CH_2_004 as we investigate.

Best regards,
Support Team
